name: Stash v0.9.114 — Fix for noisy FLAC playback on Samsung phones
body:
A quick fix for v0.9.113.

## 🐛 Fixed
- On some Samsung phones, CD-quality FLAC songs could play as loud noise. Fixed. Thanks to @ParaliyzedEvo for tracking it down and fixing it within the hour.

## 📝 Good to know
- Just update. There's no need to uninstall, restore a backup or sign in again.
